cases.draft: I just wanted to explain what happened last night because I know this is a lot but I kept thinking about how you seemed distant and I do not want there to be weirdness between us so let me lay it all out clearly.

expected.hidden: The pressure you feel is coming from inside the read, not the interaction.
expected.dont: Do not send the full paragraph. Cut it to one clean sentence.
expected.next: Reduce the message to the main point. Stop there.
expected.message: Hey. I am around whenever you want to pick this back up.
whySignals: Over-explanation detected. Creates pressure before the content lands.
expected.summary: Scenario: Text / DM. Feeling: Unsure. Desired: Get clarity.

cases.draft: It has been 4 hours since my text and he has not responded.

expected.verdict: The delay feels like rejection. It likely is not. Yet.
expected.hidden: Anxious reads are almost always more negative than the actual situation.
expected.dont: Do not send a message to manage your own anxiety. That rarely ends well.
expected.next: Wait until you feel calmer. The same message reads differently from a settled place.
expected.message: Had a really good time. We should do it again soon.
whySignals: Delay or silence mentioned. Changes the energy read significantly.
